metadata.article_title: Proceedings to be held in camera.

article.title: Proceedings to be held in camera.
article.content: In every suit or proceedings to which this Act applies, the proceedings may be held in camera if the Family Court so desires and shall be so held if either party so desires.
article.html:
11Proceedings to be held in camera.

Section 11 · Chapter IV · page 6 of the Act

In every suit or proceedings to which this Act applies, the proceedings may be held in camera if the Family Court so desires and shall be so held if either party so desires.
